description: This essential course for Physics majors introduces classical mechanics and the mathematical framework underlying advanced theoretical physics. Topics include the application of Newton’s laws to extended and rigid bodies, rotational motion through torque and angular momentum, and motion under central forces such as gravitation, including Kepler’s laws. The course also introduces Lagrangian mechanics and the Euler–Lagrange equations, equipping students with a strong foundation for further study in mechanics and theoretical physics.
